desc:
> 🎃 Knock, knock.. The season has brought the new Phantom Cup for only 14 days. 
Grab it now, because it gets more expensive every day! 👀

> ☕ A Niche Barista Game
A cozy coffee shop simulator, a game I enjoyed making and hope you enjoy also!
(Private servers are free!)

> 🎮 Gameplay
Serve various customers who request unique orders. 
Enjoy the relaxing music and gameplay, or aim to be the best barista ever.
(And don't leave the VIPs waiting!)

> 🛠️ Recent Updates [Spooky Season & 2026 Major Update]
• Limited-time recolourable cup skin!
• Limited Halloween Map + Outside access
• New accessibility menu with real-time map lighting
• Brand new Hotbar & Music System 
• Overhauled Tutorial + Controller support
• Interface changes, polish & performance
• New Passes & Shop rework

> 🤩 Thanks for playing!
Leave feedback if you'd like something added.
Thanks for the support - Have a niche day!
